<!-- INTRODUCTION -->

<div class="traffic-intro">

<span class="traffic-eyebrow">
El Paso Crime Lab / Data &amp; Tools
</span>

<h1>Traffic Data Analysis</h1>

<div class="traffic-divider"></div>

<p>
An interactive application designed to help Texas law enforcement
agencies enter, review, and analyze traffic stop data.
</p>

<p>
The application supports the examination of traffic stops,
searches, and contraband outcomes, including the comparative
analysis required under Texas Code of Criminal Procedure,
Article 2B.0053.
</p>

</div>


<!-- APPLICATION FEATURES -->

<div class="traffic-features">

<div class="traffic-feature">

<h3>Enter Data</h3>

<p>
Organize traffic stop, search, and contraband data in one
interactive application.
</p>

</div>

<div class="traffic-feature">

<h3>Review Data</h3>

<p>
Check entered information and identify potential errors
or inconsistencies.
</p>

</div>

<div class="traffic-feature">

<h3>Analyze Data</h3>

<p>
Explore patterns and comparisons to support agency
reporting and informed decision-making.
</p>

</div>

</div>


<!-- DATA PRIVACY -->

<div class="traffic-privacy">

<strong>Data privacy:</strong>
Data entered into this application is not stored or retained.
Use the Download button within the application to save a copy
of your work to your computer.

</div>
